goal: Scope the check-all GitHub token to the live gh read, and skip that read locally when gh is unavailable.
latest_observation: The gh self-test restores GITHUB_ACTIONS. After that in-process run, a hosted child with no credentials and a hosted child with a bad GH_TOKEN each exit 1 with SPLIT_GH_GIT_FAIL and do not print gh_live=SKIP_GH_UNAVAILABLE. Dropping the scoped restore fails that check.
